## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and how this change addresses it.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For documentation-only changes, describe the examples and links reviewed.

## Release impact

Note any change to public imports, icon names, types, default variants, accessibility behavior, or bundle inclusion.

- [ ] Source and generated API documentation agree.
- [ ] Relevant validation results are included.
- [ ] New or modified artwork has a compatible license and preserved attribution, or no artwork is changed.

See CONTRIBUTING.md for the contribution process and SECURITY.md for sensitive reports.
